Subject:  Funding For Street Sweeping Services Program

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Provide a recommendation to the City Council to consider
appropriating $44,160 from the General Fund Undesignated Reserve for the street
sweeping services program for a total revised budget of $139,610.

FISCAL IMPACT: Funding for the Street Sweeping Services program was included in the
Adopted Budget for FY 2024-25, for a total amount of $95,450. Based upon the cost
proposal received by the City for these services, an additional appropriation of $44,160
from the General Fund Undesignated Reserve to Account No. 100-3001-5121.01 (Street
Sweeping) is needed to perform these services. This program includes reimbursements
received from Caltrans for sweeping services performed on Pacific Coast Highway (PCH).

The projected General Fund Undesignated Reserve on June 30, 2025, is $65,446,492.

  Existing Funding  Estimated Costs  Variance
General Fund  $95,450 Cost Proposal  $139,610

  Subtotal $95,450  Subtotal $139,610 Total ($44,160)
  Additional General Fund Undesigned Reserve Request $44,160

WORK PLAN: This item is part of the day-to-day operations identified in the Adopted FY
2023-24 Strategic Priority Project List. Staff continues to work on ongoing projects and
normal business while the FY 2024-25 Strategic Priority Plan is finalized.

  Page 1 of 2
  Agenda Item 3.A.
 DISCUSSION: Council Policy #44 requires that all proposed appropriations over $10,000
be reviewed and discussed by the Administration and Finance Subcommittee prior to
being presented to the City Council. The proposed appropriation item will be presented to
the Council at its Regular meeting on September 23, 2024.

For the past 13 years the City’s existing street sweeping service has been with Venco
Power Sweeping. Venco Power Sweeping was purchased by Sweeping Corporation of
America (SCA) on December 16, 2021, and their contract is set to expire on October 8,
2024. On June 13, 2024, the City issued a new Request for Proposals for new street
sweeping services.

On August 1, 2024, one company submitted a cost proposal for street sweeping services.
The cost proposal was $139,610 which includes street sweeping PCH. Staff reviewed the
proposal and discovered the labor rates have increased significantly. The labor rates
increased from $35 per hour to $95.25 per hour. SCA mentioned that they are now
required to charge labor rates under prevailing wage laws. Staff conducted research and
discovered that the California Department of Industrial Relations confirmed that street
sweeping work performed pursuant to a contract with a municipality was categorized as
maintenance work. This revision requires any street sweeping work subject to prevailing
wages. This increase in labor rates accounts for an additional $44,160 beyond the Fiscal
Year 2024-25 Adopted Budget.

Additional appropriation is needed to continue to provide these services. Staff
recommends an additional $44,160 to be allocated from the General Fund Undesignated
Reserve to execute a services agreement with SCA of CA, LLC.

In 2006, the City entered into a maintenance agreement with Caltrans for street sweeping
on PCH. The agreement requires Caltrans to reimburse the City for all expenses
associated with sweeping PCH. This agreement was updated in 2014 to increase the
frequency to weekly and revise the amount to be reimbursed.

ATTACHMENTS: None.
